name: palmora-ai-monorepo
description: Palmora AI monorepo linking web frontend, shared contracts, and services

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @palmora/shared-types run build && pnpm --filter @palmora/web run build && node scripts/prepare-vercel.cjs
scripts.check:types: npm --workspace=@palmora/shared-types run check:types && npm --workspace=@palmora/web run check:types
scripts.build:web: npm --workspace=@palmora/shared-types run build && npm --workspace=@palmora/web run build
